Pubpeer, the open discussion platform for published scientific articles

This website has been a gamechanger in peer-reviewed published science. On one hand people are free to discuss the implications of specific papers, their methodology, as well as their impact. On the other hand, this website has allowed for people to discuss and comment potential scientific misconduct (for instance, pointing out photoshopped pictures or misrepresentation of data) and has resulted in a surge of retractions of papers ranging from recent to having been published well over a decade. This is one of the initiatives that hopefully will add to the much needed transparency in our current publication system.

Thanks for submitting this. Somehow I had never heard of it. It seems like the majority of comments are of the negative variety - either downplaying the importance of work, or calling out suspected misconduct. It would be nice to see scientists being supportive of others' work too, but I guess that's the nature of the game.
